hot as death / dying of heat
จะตาย the everyday intensifier

rule: ตาย's chain runs from a death (1) to a body that cannot move (2) to a value that will not change (4), and a compound files by which of those three the word is actually about. Sense 1 keeps everything where something really dies or is killed, the figurative uses included — a friend you would die for, a tree dead on its feet, a finishing blow. Sense 2 takes what is inert or unfeeling: skin, a face, a heart that stops being wary, a syllable whose sound stops. Sense 4, whose member ตายตัว is fixedness itself, takes what is settled and will not shift — a date, a certainty, a card stuck in the hand, a door shut for good. Sense 7 is the bleached intensifier.
